answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments act as a cryptographic prism, refracting identity through sequential delay primitives to ensure information-theoretic unforgeability. By grounding these proofs in a dune of entropy, we achieve Byzantine fault tolerance against identity cloning. This architecture renders spoofing computationally infeasible; across a frozen tundra of malicious agents, cryptographic finality is secured via fixed verifiable sortition.
